result.period_semantics: [period_start, period_end): start inclusive, end exclusive, in company timezone
result.cutoff_basis: A document belongs to the period of its own timestamp (invoice issued_at / payment timestamp) in company timezone. Every ledger row posted for the document must fall on the same side of the period boundaries (before / in / after) as the document. Records outside the period exist.
result.fx_rate_date: local date (company timezone) of the payment document timestamp
result.fx_lookup: fx.csv row with date = that local date, source_currency = payment currency, target_currency = invoice currency; rate = target units per 1 source unit (major units)
result.fx_booking: Cross-currency receipt posts: Dr CASH (payment ccy); Cr FX_CLEARING (payment ccy, allocated amount); Dr FX_CLEARING + Cr AR (invoice ccy, converted allocated amount); remainder Cr UNAPPLIED (payment ccy)

rounding.rule: converted amount rounded once to the minor unit of the target currency

result.duplicate_rule: two invoices with the same entity, the same po_ref and the same set of line items
result.allocation_rule: invoice_refs[].allocated_minor is in payment currency. A receipt whose memo names invoices must allocate its full amount to them; null = not allocated. An advance payment on account (memo names no invoice, invoice_refs = []) legitimately stays in UNAPPLIED and is NOT an error.
result.null_semantics: null in a reference field means the link is absent; links are never guessed

duplicate_invoice.affected_ids: both invoice_id values (original and repeated invoice), any order
duplicate_invoice.claimed_amount_minor: total_minor of one of the two invoices

payment_allocation.affected_ids: [payment_id, invoice_id named in the payment memo]
payment_allocation.claimed_amount_minor: payment amount_minor minus sum(invoice_refs.allocated_minor) (null refs count as 0), in PAYMENT currency
payment_allocation.evidence_ids: payment doc_id + row_id of the ledger UNAPPLIED row

fx_error.claimed_amount_minor: |booked AR credit - correct conversion of the allocated amount| in INVOICE currency
fx_error.evidence_ids: payment doc_id + row_id of the AR credit row (or the FX_CLEARING row in invoice currency) + fx record id of the correct rate

period_cutoff.affected_ids: [invoice_id] or [payment_id] of the document posted on the wrong side of the period boundary
period_cutoff.evidence_ids: document doc_id + a ledger row_id posted for it (invoice: AR or REVENUE row; payment: CASH row)
